title: Panchalankurichi
desc: Raised under Mayandi's roof, Kittan finds himself at odds with the family's rival, Kali. However, a budding romance threatens to complicate matters further.

title: Aarilirunthu Arubathu Varai
desc: Santhanam gives the best education to his siblings and takes care of all their basic needs. However, when they become financially stable they ill-treat and ignore him until he becomes a famous writer.

title: Panam Padaithavan
desc: Raja is in love with someone else, but he must choose between his love and family.

title: Shankarlal
desc: A criminal, Chelladurai, frames the innocent Dharmalingam for a crime which leads to the latter being jailed. Years later, Dharmalingam returns to take revenge and establish contact with his family.

title: Captain Prabhakar
desc: Prabhakaran, a forest officer, is assigned to arrest the notorious smuggler Veerabhadran. While duty calls, Prabhakaran also decides to avenge his friend's death.
